name: write-issue
description: Write, publish and maintain GitHub issues on a project board, with org issue fields set and verified after creation.

interface.shortDescription: Short, contract-style GitHub issues with their board fields set.
interface.longDescription: Drafts issues per kind (feature, bug, task, research, epic), gates publishing and the ready-for-agent label on the human, sets Type, App, Execution, Priority, Size, Status and parent through GraphQL and reads them back, and surveys a board for stale, orphaned and over-long issues.
